field_definitions.nodes: Total structured graph entities (e.g., services, APIs, ADRs, requirements, owners, repos, tickets). Modeled at ~1 KiB/node base row.
field_definitions.edges: Total logical & explicit graph relationships (CALLS_API, DEPENDS_ON, GOVERNS, APPLIES_TO, etc.). Modeled at ~256 B/edge + ~2.0x reverse covering STORING indexes.
field_definitions.chunks: Total unstructured Markdown/doc/runbook chunks in DocumentChunks. Modeled at ~2 KiB text + 3.0 KiB (768-dim FLOAT32 embedding) + ~0.5x FTS index + ~1.3x ScaNN vector index.
field_definitions.qps: Peak sustained combined read + write GraphRAG requests per second. Regional 3-zone sizing enforces < 65% High-Priority CPU headroom.
field_definitions.write_pct: Percentage of total QPS that are multi-model writes (0-100; typical enterprise SDLC KG is 10-20%).
field_definitions.vector_dim: FLOAT32 embedding dimensionality (default 768 for Vertex AI gemini-embedding-001 = 3.0 KiB/chunk).
field_definitions.cold_hdd_pct: Percentage of archival non-key storage (0-100) tiered from SSD ($0.315/GiB-mo in Bangkok) to HDD ($0.063/GiB-mo = 5x savings) via Locality Groups. Keep hot PKs & indexes on SSD!
field_definitions.region: Primary Cloud Spanner Enterprise region: 'asia-southeast3' (Bangkok, Thailand PDPA resident, 99.99% 3-zone SLA, $1.2915/node-hr) | 'asia-southeast1' (Singapore, $1.40712/node-hr) | 'us-central1' (Iowa reference, $1.23/node-hr).
field_definitions.dr_backup_region: Optional cross-region backup copy destination ('asia-southeast1' recommended for Bangkok DR: $0.08/GiB Asia egress + $0.03432/GiB-mo DR storage; set to 'none' to disable).
field_definitions.edition: Cloud Spanner edition: 'enterprise' (required minimum for Spanner Graph, FTS, ScaNN Vector Search, Locality Groups, Managed Autoscaler) or 'enterprise_plus'.
field_definitions.ro_replicas: Optional additional read-only replicas per node for ultra-high read isolation ($0.4305/node-hr in Bangkok Enterprise; default 0).
field_definitions.enable_primary_backup: Set true for production (AUTOMATIC backups + 7-day PITR). Production ALWAYS requires >= 1,000 PUs (1 node); 100 PUs is strictly workshop/dev sandbox only!

workload_name: Enterprise SDLC Knowledge Graph & GraphRAG Consolidation (Bangkok + Singapore DR)
use_case: Consolidate Neo4j CE + Separate Vector DB + Separate Keyword Search Cluster into Cloud Spanner Enterprise
notes: Sample mid-sized enterprise baseline (500k nodes, 2.5M edges, 1.2M chunks, 180 QPS, 40% HDD cold archive) running primary in Bangkok (asia-southeast3) with cross-region DR backup copies in Singapore (asia-southeast1).
